description: SDPB-style staircase EW-residual derivation at k=3 — analogue of probe_sdpb_pl_crossing_equations.py (commit 5e7459cf0). Sets up a Wedderburn-block SDP over the 11 partitions of n_3=6 with Hoefsmit-σ-symmetric PSD block matrices, mirror-parity constraints, normalisation, Markov-pair-trace saturation, and an `a` parameter (EW residual scale) to maximise. Reports the SDP optimum and the best-match substrate scale (z_markov, 1/h_corner, q^(1/5), etc.). CAVEAT: constraints 5-6 are heuristic stand-ins mirroring the PL probe's structure, NOT derived from a categorical crossing-equation analysis of V_(3,2,1). Treat as directional: which substrate scale does the analogue-of-PL SDP saturate to?
caveats: Heuristic SDP scaffolding: constraints 5-6 (Markov-pair saturation, a-consistency) MIRROR the PL probe's structure but are NOT derived from a categorical crossing-equation analysis specific to V_(3,2,1). The SDP-saturating value reported should be read as directional evidence about which substrate scale (z_markov, ℏ_q, 1/h_corner, q^p/q) appears naturally in the optimisation, not as a substrate derivation of the EW residual. A real derivation would replace the heuristic constraints with rigorous ones (e.g. via prop:operator-selection-sdp categorical bootstrap).
